svg.title: LabOS System Architecture
svg.text: One central server • many PCs • shared knowledge and experimental evidence
Browser only • question, review and authorize
Scientific reasoning + deterministic control + durable evidence on one server
Scientific objective → measurement strategy → evidence-based next step
Delegate specialist work • compare controls • propose the next scientific stage
Per-PC identity • deadlines • cancellation • qualification • exclusive device ownership
Fallback: local LLM on this server
Server: cloud / local LLM routing. Instrument PCs: execution workers; no PC-side LLM required.
A/B retain the supplied setup; C…N illustrate additional hosts. Hardware trigger / reference wiring is separate from HTTP(S).
One experiment → coordinated stages across PCs
Original LabOS system-design figure • scalable deployment view
